title: Cost Management: budgets, alerts and cost analysis

videos.script: A budget sounds like a limit. A number you cannot go past. In Azure it is not. {{limit}} A budget is an amount and a few thresholds. When the bill crosses one, somebody gets an e-mail. The machines keep running. {{email}} This lesson writes the budget the first lesson promised. Fifty a month, for the shop's production subscription. {{bicep}} It has two alerts, and they ask two different questions. {{two}} The first fires when eighty per cent has already been spent. It is certain, and it is late. {{actual}} The second fires when the forecast for the month passes the whole amount. It can be wrong. But it arrives while there is still time. {{forecast}} And all of it runs a day behind. Costs take hours to arrive, and budgets are checked once a day. {{delay}} Then you break the budget on purpose, with one misspelt word, and see which tool notices. {{typo}} Last, cost analysis: where you go when an alert fires, to find out what is spending, and whose it is. {{end}}
